description: Three hand-rolled editors inside Svelte 5 grid cells: a native colour picker bound to a tag swatch, a 5-star rating and an emoji mood control, set in a quarterly feature-health review. Each lives in a cell snippet that handles its own interaction and writes the new value with api.setCellValue, and inner click handlers stop propagation so the grid's cell click does not fight the control.

faq.question: How does a control inside a cell write back to the row?
faq.answer: Call api.setCellValue with the row index, the column id and the new value from the control's event handler. The grid updates the row and fires onCellValueChange the same way a built-in editor would.

faq.question: Why stop propagation inside the snippet?
faq.answer: A click on the star or the colour input is also a click on the cell. Stopping propagation keeps the grid from treating it as a cell click, so the control gets the interaction and the selection does not jump.

faq.question: Can these controls coexist with built-in editors?
faq.answer: Yes. The other columns in this grid use editorType editors that open on double-click or F2, while the snippet columns handle their own input inline.
